title: Evolving the Google Identity / Logotype
slide_intent: Retain familiar color and introduce simpler letterforms so people can recognize a brand as its contexts change.
strategic_value: The familiar color sequence and rotated e can connect Google’s 2015 identity to earlier encounters while the geometric letters support a simpler presentation.
demonstration: A large six-letter multicolored Google wordmark sits alone on a white field.
practical_value: Evaluate the recognition carried by color order and one distinctive letter before adding supporting graphics.

content_islands.name: Logotype
content_islands.spec: Center the multicolored wordmark on white and leave generous space on every side.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying official article explains the aim of retaining an approachable character while adapting to new devices and surfaces.
reference_purposes.Expression: The isolated wordmark demonstrates the geometric letterforms, four-color sequence and tilted e.

ingredient.name: 2015 Google wordmark
ingredient.role: Identify Google through a familiar color sequence and approachable letterforms.
ingredient.application: Preserve the demonstrated color sequence and rotated e when examining this historical mark.
ingredient.scope: The 2015 identity presentation; this image is not a current logo usage manual.
